note: The Annex lists ONLY mineral carbonates in construction products as eligible permanently-chemically-bound uses. Consequence: CO2 bound in urea or soda ash is NOT deductible under MRR Art 49a or 2025/2547 Annex II B.8.2(1)(b). Training materials teaching a urea product-bound deduction are wrong under definitive-period law.

SUPERSEDED for the definitive period by 2025/2547. Kept in corpus because transitional-period reports were filed under it; never cite it for definitive-period monitoring-plan content. Widely-circulated training decks still cite this act's framing.
Omnibus de-minimis: 50 t net mass per importer per year (Annex VII method), NOT applicable to electricity or hydrogen imports. Replaces the old 150 EUR consignment threshold.
